description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IMediaKeysModuleService in the Rialto media server IPC layer. It includes class declarations for the service interface, a factory class to create instances, and methods for managing IPC client connections.

classes.name: IMediaKeysModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaKeysModuleService.

classes.name: IMediaKeysModuleService
classes.description: Interface for the MediaKeysModule service, handling IPC client connections.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaKeysModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysModuleService, given a reference to an ICdmService.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles logic when an IPC client connects.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles logic when an IPC client disconnects.
